A /reload-plugins churned 2+ catalogs in one turn. It resets the prefix ONLY when a reloaded plugin supplies an MCP server whose tools load into the prefix — per the docs, "skills, commands, agents, hooks, LSP servers, monitors, and themes never invalidate the cache". Since v2.1.163 the command warns and skips such a reload unless --force, so check whether --force was passed before blaming the reload.
